newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tradewinds to boost oil palm holdings.
newsitem.headline: Tradewinds to boost oil palm holdings.

text.p: Tradewinds (M) Bhd said a unit has agreed to acquire a 70 percent stake in an oil palm plantation developer for 31.51 million ringgit cash.
In a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Thursday, Tradewinds said its Amalan Penaga (M) Sdn Bhd unit set the agreement with Melur Gemilang Sdn Bhd.
Melur has applied for 15,000 hectares of land in Sebuyau, in the Borneo island-based state of Sarawak, for the purpose of development into oil palm plantations.
The proposed acquisition is in line with Tradewinds' strategy of expanding its oil palm plantations in Sarawak, the statement said.
